lessons: Keep the passing receipt, digest, incomplete-grade NO_GO, identity-mapping, fence and no-successor tests unchanged. Only one acceptance clause is unmet.

Bind the committed host-loop-report.json to the registered producer. Run host_loop.run() once in a module-scoped fixture, then assert that the committed entries' (member, scenario) pairs and producing_run stems equal the fixture report's.
Or, at minimum, assert that every committed entry's stem and scenario comes from host_loop.STEMS / host_loop.INITIAL_SCENARIOS.

Add a negative case: a report with the right shape but scenarios or producing_run stems outside the fixture registry must fail that same check. This proves fabricated or live-host evidence is rejected.
A static scan of the test's own source for journal imports does not prove evidence provenance. Put the provenance check on the OUTBOX artifact bytes.
Write only inside the fence: the two tickets/phase6-exit JSON files and tests/test_phase6_exit.py. Make no engine-code edits.
